title: Issue AC 3 (formal /bug-hunt scenario re-run) not evidenced — PR claims equivalent live-browser repro instead
evidence: Issue acceptance: "- [ ] `/bug-hunt reference_checks panel-correct` and `panel-substitute` pass"; constraints: "Re-run with `/bug-hunt reference_checks panel-correct` (and `panel-substitute`) — expected PASS." PR body verification says: "**Live browser repro** (local sandbox, real bundle): typed values now hold in all three fields on both panel-correct and panel-substitute; Save → success toast **and** DB shows the new contact with `correction_cycles=1`; substitute creates the new referee row." The scenario suite isn't in the repo to re-run: `git ls-tree 758f1d8 .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/` lists analytics…workflows with no reference_checks entry (e.g. "040000 tree 160c5c89bf6eef1364dad0e0f2a63971416a229c	.pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/vacancies", "040000 tree bd295a88217f77e2d0853a9fe95558733455fab9	.pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/workflows").
detail: The issue's acceptance explicitly demands the bug-hunt scenarios pass; the PR evidences a manual live-browser repro covering the same behavior (typing holds, DB persists new contact, substitute submits) but never claims the scenarios were executed. Perkins cannot audit the formal re-run.
recommended_fix: Either re-run the panel-correct/panel-substitute scenarios with the bug-hunt skill and cite the result, or state explicitly in the PR why the live repro supersedes the scenario re-run.

title: Briefing 'fail loud' runtime requirement not implemented — deviation documented and justified in PR body
location: N/A (runtime untouched — see commit file list)
evidence: Briefing fix requirement: "4. Fail loud, not silent: if an event path can't dispatch, it must surface an error — no `DispatchedEvent` swallow without a log/exception (the silent class is what made this bug invisible for days)." Commit touches only app/test files: "client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam |  6 +--", "client/test/client_test.gleam               | 78 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++", "2 files changed, 81 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)". PR body: "**Loud-failure note**: the issue's acceptance asked for a loud failure in the runtime event path. Since the runtime isn't at fault, the durable guarantee is the pin test — it fails on any regression of the view→dict key wiring (the actual swallow class), which is the app-side contract we own."
detail: The briefing lists the loud-failure mechanism as a 'must'; the diff implements none of it. The deviation is explicit: the PR's instrumentation falsified the issue's runtime-swallow premise (events dispatch; the bug was a dict-key mismatch), and the pin test is offered as the durable guarantee. Deviation is justified and conditional-premise-safe, but it is a literal miss of a stated must-item.
recommended_fix: Accept the documented deviation (runtime premise disproven, regression pinned by a biting test), or note in the review that a runtime-warning safeguard was explicitly waived by the PR's evidence.

title: Pin test exercises only the correct-form trio; the substitute form's half of the acceptance is unautomated
evidence:
Issue acceptance: "- [ ] Fix landed — typing in the correct-details and substitute forms updates the model; Save persists the NEW contact". The pin test builds one row and one edit kind: "      reference_call.ReferenceCallDetail(
        ..refcheck_call("rc-1", reference_call.AwaitingCorrection)," and "            kind: model.RefcheckEditCorrect," — no substitute-kind (RefcheckEditSubstitute) row is ever simulated, and no second row tests per-row isolation.
detail: Both forms share view_edit_trio, so the one-line fix structurally covers substitute too, and the PR claims live substitute verification. But the automated pin only drives RefcheckEditCorrect — a future regression confined to the substitute branch or to two same-slot rows would not fail any client test.
recommended_fix: Add a sibling simulate test: an Objected/Unreachable row with can_substitute_referee=True seeded as RefcheckEditSubstitute, typing into its trio and asserting the dict write under the row id.
